revisions.purpose: Release0.3.24: UTe2 and Sr2RuO4 get their own structure drawings on the Tc chart, replacing a shared pairing-symmetry cartoon that also showed the kagome lattice of CsV3Sb5, a different material; UTe2 shows the uranium two-leg ladder along the a axis of the body-centred orthorhombic Immm structure at the reported U-U distances of about 4.2 A along the legs and 3.8 A across the rungs, with a Te(2) chain along b, two indicative Te(1) markers and a turning view that changes no distance; Sr2RuO4 shows its layered perovskite of corner-sharing RuO6 octahedra with apical oxygen and strontium between the planes, drawn untilted; the shared triplet drawing is unchanged and still serves the Spin-triplet candidates card, which covers all three materials; UTe2's note records that cleaner crystals later reached about 2.1 K after the 1.6 K of the cited 2019 report; the chart, its data, the models and the results are otherwise unchanged
